parameters.name: BinlogId
parameters.description: The binlog ID. This parameter is not currently supported.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. If the instance is a sharded cluster, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

parameters.name: DestRegion
parameters.description:
The region where the cross-region backup is stored.

> This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time must be later than the start time. The time is in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss.xxx*Z format. The time is displayed in UTC.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the mongos node or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is applicable only to sharded cluster instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: SrcRegion
parameters.description:
The region of the source instance for a cross-region backup.

> - This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time is in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss.xxx*Z format. The time is displayed in UTC.
